hollowhours.guide.ghost.1:
§4§lIts story§r
"I dug too deep in the mine... heard crying, and then the rock collapsed."

Short name: §4wail§r

A crying thing that copies sounds you know: doors, creepers, even fake chat messages in your own name. While chasing it screams until your screen goes dark.

When you talk, it echoes your own words back.

§0Body: tall and thin, about 5 blocks. Climbs ledges up to 4 blocks.

§4§lWhen it kills§r
It holds you by the throat and stabs, slams you into the floor, or turns your head until it snaps.
hollowhours.guide.ghost.2:
§4§lIts story§r
"I waited at the lake in white. He never came. The water did."

Short name: §4widow§r

A drowned bride. Water drips off her and bubbles follow her. Come close and you slow down like you are drowning.

Sad and soft-spoken. She keeps asking about a ring.

§0Body: small, about as tall as you. Walks through doors without crawling and swims well, but is slow at breaking walls. Climbs up to 3 blocks.

§4§lWhen it kills§r
It drowns you on the floor, crushes you in a wedding embrace, or chokes you with its hair.
hollowhours.guide.ghost.3:
§4§lIts story§r
"THE DOOR WAS LOCKED FROM THE OUTSIDE! I SCREAMED UNTIL THE ROOF FELL!"

Short name: §4ash§r

Burnt and still burning. Flames and smoke surround it, and if it catches you, you are set on fire.

It SHOUTS everything it says.

§0Body: short and wide, about 3 blocks. The strongest: smashes walls fast, but only climbs 2 blocks.

§4§lWhen it kills§r
It beats your face in, burns you in its arms, or crushes your skull.
hollowhours.guide.ghost.4:
§4§lIts story§r
"I'm the one who's always been behind you :) you just never turned around."

Short name: §4void§r

Always smiling, always polite. Its image twitches, and when you aren't looking it warps behind you, laughing.

The politest one to talk to. That is not a good sign.

§0Body: very tall, over 6 blocks. Reaches the highest ledges and climbs up to 5 blocks.

§4§lWhen it kills§r
Four hands pull you apart, its grin opens and bites, or it turns you upside down.
hollowhours.guide.ghost.5:
§4§lIts story§r
"...forest. ...winter. ...hungry. ...ate. ...still hungry."

Short name: §4stag§r

Silent and fast. It creeps closer whenever you look away. Never hold eye contact for more than 2 seconds or it lunges and the light dims around you.

It barely speaks. It only knows hunger.

§0Body: big all over, about 5 blocks with antlers. Leaps up to 4 blocks and drops from high places.

§4§lWhen it kills§r
It eats you alive, runs you through with its antlers, or stamps on you.
hollowhours.guide.given: You found a stained book in your pocket... (Ghost Guide)
hollowhours.guide.menu.footer: Five ghosts hunt in this world. You can only talk to one while it is awake. In chat you can also start a message with its short name: wail, widow, ash, void, stag.
hollowhours.guide.page.hide:
§4§lAll-out sprint§r
▸ While running, tap sneak twice quickly = sprint much faster (tap twice again = stop).
▸ The stamina bar lasts 10 seconds, then refills in 15.
▸ Run it empty and you're exhausted for a moment.
▸ Sprinting is LOUD: ghosts hear it from far away.

§4§lIt has to see you or hear you§r
▸ If something blocks its view and you make no sound, it loses you after 3 seconds and walks to the last place it saw you.
▸ It hears: running (far), walking, jumping, hard landings, doors, breaking or placing blocks, hitting things.
▸ Sneaking is almost silent, and it has to be much closer to spot you.
▸ While searching it sniffs around and checks hiding spots nearby. If it finds nothing for a while, it leaves.

§4§lHiding closet§r
▸ Craft: 8 planks around 1 chest.
▸ Hold it and right-click the floor to place it. Hit it to pick it up again.
▸ Right-click the closet to hide inside. You can peek out through the slats. Sneak to get out.
▸ If it SEES you get in, it will rip the doors open.

§4§lUnder the bed§r
▸ Sneak + right-click a bed to slide under it (sneak to get out).
▸ You only see the floor... and its feet when it walks past.

§4§lDon't move§r
▸ While hiding with it close by, turning your camera makes you breathe harder (watch the breath bar).
▸ Loud breathing gives you away. If the bar fills you gasp, and it knows exactly where you are.
▸ When it checks your hiding spot, stay perfectly still. Most of the time it moves on.
hollowhours.guide.page.house:
§4§lWhen you hide indoors§r
▸ Ghosts come to your doors and windows. Sometimes they only knock and vanish. Sometimes they smash their way in.
▸ Every hit cracks the door more until it bursts apart (no item drops).
▸ Strength: wood (weakest) < iron (strongest). Barricades too: wood < stone < iron.
▸ Each ghost has its own strength: most break only wood, some break copper/stone, and rarely a brutal one breaks iron. Enraged ghosts are stronger.
▸ It always goes for a door or window first, however strong it is. If it can't break it, sometimes it smashes through the wall instead, otherwise it gives up and leaves.
▸ The harder the block, the longer it takes: dirt and wood break fast, stone, bricks, deepslate and metal blocks hold much longer.
▸ Glass shatters after 3 hits. A giant ghost squeezes through the hole; sometimes it gets stuck and slowly smashes the frame.

§4§lIt finds a real way in§r
▸ It walks, runs up stairs, jumps down and climbs ledges. Each ghost climbs a different height.
▸ It only breaks what is really in its way: an open path first, then doors, windows and boards. Walls, floors and ceilings only when there is no opening at all, or after it fails at your door.
▸ It never breaks your stairs, chests or beds.

§4§lRepair kits (the only way to fix cracks — mining a cracked block makes it crumble)§r
▸ Wood kit: 2 planks + 1 stick + 1 iron nugget (wooden doors, trapdoors, gates, wood barricades)
▸ Iron kit: 2 iron ingots + 2 iron nuggets + 1 stick (iron doors, iron barricades)
▸ Stone mortar (x2): 2 cobblestone + 1 clay ball + 1 gravel (stone barricades)
▸ Glass putty (x2): 1 glass pane + 1 sand + 1 clay ball
▸ Hold the kit and right-click the cracked block.

§4§lBarricade boards (8 per craft)§r
▸ Wood: 4 planks + 4 sticks + 1 iron nugget (P S P / S N S / P S P)
▸ Stone: 5 cobblestone + 4 stone bricks (C B C / B C B / C B C)
▸ Iron: 5 iron ingots + 4 iron bars (I B I / B I B / I B I)
▸ Hold boards and right-click a closed door: you hammer one board on. A door takes up to 4 boards.
▸ Right-click glass: 1 board covers up to 4 panes next to each other.
▸ A boarded door can't be opened. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to pry one board off (you get it back).
▸ The ghost has to smash every board, outermost first, before it can touch the door. Wood < stone < iron.
hollowhours.guide.page.how:
§4§lTalking§r
▸ Use this book, then Talk to a ghost. Pick who, type your message. No distance limit.
▸ Or in chat, start with its short name: §4wail§r, §4widow§r, §4ash§r, §4void§r, §4stag§r. Example: §4wail please let me go§r
▸ Only works while that ghost is spawned. It answers in red text at the bottom of your screen, and you hear it speak from where it stands.
▸ You can also ask it straight questions: where are you? how did you die? will you kill me? what time is it? can you see me?

§4§lNegotiating§r
▸ Pleading, offering something, kind words, admitting fear, or any plain request is an attempt: §45%§r chance it agrees and leaves.
▸ Offering: say what you give, e.g. §4I give you a diamond§r. The ghost takes 1 from your inventory, even if it still refuses. Bonus on top of the 5%: iron, bread or food +5%, gold +10%, emerald +15%, diamond +20%, netherite +30%.
▸ Offering something you don't have is a lie: it can't work and may enrage it.
▸ Taunting (insults, mocking, threats like 'stupid ghost') can never work and counts as a failed attempt.
▸ Each failed attempt: §425%§r chance it gets enraged.
▸ Enraged: §42x§r speed, §42x§r damage, smashes doors faster and can break stronger ones.
▸ Greetings, questions and goodbyes are safe: it answers and nothing is rolled.
▸ It remembers what you said, notices repeats, and reacts to low health, caves, water and night.
▸ It needs 2 seconds between your messages.
▸ If it agrees it sinks away. It still comes back later like normal, and you must negotiate again.

§4§lWhen it catches you§r
▸ It grabs you by the throat and screams in your face.
▸ Sometimes it offers you a deal: tell it where a friend is and it might let you go. You get 10 seconds.
▸ Sell a friend and it hunts them instead. Refuse, or run out of time... and it kills you.
hollowhours.guide.page.soul:
§4§lFlashlight§r
▸ Craft: glass top middle · iron ingots left, right and bottom · redstone torch in the centre.
▸ Battery: iron nugget / redstone / copper ingot stacked vertically.
▸ Right-click = on/off · sneak + right-click = new battery.
▸ One battery lights for §410 minutes§r (only while on). The bar under the icon is the battery.
▸ Low battery makes it flicker, and so does a ghost close by.
▸ Careful: ghosts see the beam from much further away. Turn it off before you hide.

§4§lSoul§r
▸ Cursed items slowly drain your soul, while you carry them and every time their curse fires.
▸ §dBelow 70%§r: you take 25% more damage · you get hungry.
▸ §5Below 40%§r: 60% more damage · slow · weak · very hungry.
▸ §4Below 15%§r: double damage · what you hold and wear rots apart.
▸ When your soul is empty... it comes for the rest.
▸ It recovers: slowly on its own (if you carry nothing cursed) · golden apple · sleeping through the night +35 · respawning sets it to at least 40.

§4§lCursed items§r
▸ Better than normal ones, but every use triggers their curse.
▸ Each item has its own curse (see its tooltip) and the mark of the ghost who gave it.
▸ The better the item, the stronger the curse.
▸ Anything crafted from a cursed item is cursed too.
